descriptionChirho: The Hebrew proper name Eliphelet (אֱלִיפֶלֶט, meaning 'my God is deliverance'), borne by sons of David (2 Sam 5:16, 1 Chr 3:8, 14:7) and other individuals in Ezra 8:13, 10:33. All 9 occurrences share a single referent across grammatical contexts: with conjunction 'and–Eliphelet' (eng: and–Eliphalet/and–Elifelet, arb: وَ–أَليفالِط, spa: y–Elifelet, swa: na–Elifeleti), nominative 'Eliphelet' (arb: أَلِيفَلِطُ, kor: 엘리페렛, hin: एलीपेलेत), and the variant spelling 'Elpalet' (eng: and–Elpalet, arb: وَ–أَلْفَلَطُ, swa: na–Elpaleti). These are purely orthographic and syntactic variants of a single proper noun.
